entries.good_example:
cleanup() { echo "Removing temp files..."; rm -f "$TMP"; exit; }
trap cleanup SIGINT SIGTERM EXIT
entries.rationale: Scripts interrupted by Ctrl+C or system shutdown often leave orphaned files or locked databases. SS QLM requires a unified cleanup function attached to termination signals.
Background jobs can become zombies if the parent script dies. SS QLM mandates capturing PIDs and ensuring they are terminated when the parent exits.
